correctness.rationale: The row energy identity and congruence by the inverse of B turn maximization of the worst-direction decrement into the diagonal-majorant SDP. Every feasible q is positive and a paired unit-diagonal PSD dual with equal objective certifies optimality. For the weak edge, the slack form divided by w is sum of squared path increments minus t times the square of their sum; the equality spaces are constant vectors below threshold and affine paths at threshold. Above threshold the sine ratio is strictly increasing by strict decrease of u cot u on (0,π). With ℓ=n−1 and ϕ=ℓθ the interior slack block is positive definite, with eigenvalues 2cosθ−2cos(kπ/ℓ)>0. Its inverse has corner entries sin((ℓ−1)θ)/sinϕ on the diagonal and sinθ/sinϕ off the diagonal, by the trigonometric recurrence. The boundary block less the interior Schur term vanishes: the off-diagonal cancels t, and the diagonal cancels by sin((ℓ−1)θ)/sinϕ=cosθ−t cosϕ. This certifies PSD and nullity two, not just stationarity. The planar Gram certificate attains T and complementarity forces each q_i to be unique because its dual diagonal equals one. At the threshold the slack has nullity two even though a rank-one dual certificate still suffices; these are different assertions. In fact, a dual on the affine kernel with unit diagonal has constant quadratic diagonal in the vertex index, forcing the rank-one Gram there. The derivative −I of diag(C⁻¹) in the diagonal parameters at C=I gives normalization by the implicit-function theorem. The verifier was inspected, not executed.

Cycle elliptopes admit a general cosine/metric-polytope feasibility description; the inspected passages are not an evaluated weighted support function. value.rationale: A weighted frustrated cycle is a dimension-uniform structured class where independent one-step sampling can be evaluated without a generic numerical SDP. The exact closing-edge transition, unique positive probabilities, and global strong-edge certificate provide useful behavior beyond the already known resistance test and four-row computation. This is not a claim about multistep or adaptive optimality.
